fact: MCTES data reported by Jornal Noticias say more than 33,000 public servants, state agents and young people were trained in ICT use in 2020-2023 through INAGE, and 87,931 in 2015-2023.
The article says 7,033 public servants (3,746 women, 3,287 men) have been trained in digital skills under the Public Administration Reform and Modernisation Programme.

fact: At the GovNet Plus closing ceremony INAGE reported that 1,352 state administration employees received ICT training, covering office applications, email, internet and cybersecurity, in a project funded by Italy's AICS.

INTIC, UNDP and the national elections commission are running a training of 26 institutional trainers on using, assessing and supervising AI tools in election administration, 19 to 23 October 2026, to pass skills on within their institutions.
